other_conditions: Must be an in‑service school teacher, special educator, or head of school working in recognized government or aided primary/middle/high or secondary schools in Goa.
Must have at least 5 years of regular teaching service as of 30 June 2019 after probation, within the State of Goa.
Must not be retired or due for retirement in the award year.
Must not have any pending vigilance or criminal case.
Must not have indulged in private tuition.
Contractual teachers, para teachers, part‑time instructors and NSQF instructors are ineligible.
Applicants who have previously received the State Teacher Award are ineligible.
benefits_summary: Each awardee receives a monetary award of ₹100,000 along with a citation.
